about_p1: Guideon is Oman's leading platform connecting travellers with local tour guides and tour companies. The majority of our guides — and every registered tour company — are licensed by the Ministry of Heritage & Tourism, clearly marked with a Verified badge. Founded in 2026, we make authentic Omani experiences accessible to everyone.
about_p2: Every profile is reviewed by our team. The majority of our active guides — and all registered tour companies — hold a Ministry of Heritage & Tourism licence and carry a clear Verified badge, so you can book with confidence.
about_v1_desc: To make authentic Omani travel experiences accessible to every visitor through verified, professional local guides.
about_v2_desc: To become the most trusted travel platform in Oman, celebrating the country's rich heritage and natural beauty.
about_v3_desc: Authenticity, transparency, and community. We connect people, not just places — supporting local guides and their families.
about_v4_desc: Most guides on Guideon — and 100% of registered companies — are Ministry-licensed. The ✓ Verified badge confirms our team has reviewed the licence.

faq_more_q_sub: Our team replies within a few hours.
faq_t_q1: How do I book a tour?
faq_t_a1: Browse guides via the search page, select a tour package, choose a date and number of people, then click "Book Now." The guide confirms within 24 hours and you receive an email with a PDF voucher.
faq_t_a2: Yes — Guideon only approves guides who hold a valid licence from Oman's Ministry of Heritage and Tourism. Each guide profile shows a "Ministry Licensed" badge once verified.
faq_t_a3: Most guides speak both Arabic and English. Many also speak French, German, Spanish, Italian, or Russian. Filter by language in the search page.
faq_t_a4_1: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before the tour — full refund.
faq_t_a4_4: Bad weather or government restrictions — full refund regardless.
faq_t_q5: What if the guide doesn't show up?
faq_t_a5: Contact us immediately via WhatsApp +968 9525 5450 or email. You receive a full refund plus a 10% Guideon credit for rebooking.
faq_t_q6: Can I message the guide before booking?
faq_t_a6: Yes. After signing in, every guide profile has a "Message" button. Ask about availability, pricing, or any special requests before confirming.
faq_t_q7: Is it safe to travel with a stranger?
faq_t_a7: Every Guideon guide is licensed, verified, and reviewed by previous tourists. You can read all reviews on a guide's profile. For solo travelers we also recommend choosing guides with 10+ reviews and a 4.5+ rating.
faq_t_q8: What should I wear or bring?
faq_t_a8: Modest clothing covering shoulders and knees is appreciated, especially at mosques. For desert/wadi tours bring sun protection and water shoes. Each tour page lists specific recommendations.
faq_g_q1: How do I join as a guide?
faq_g_a1: Register at guideon.om/register, complete your profile, upload your MoHT licence, and submit for verification. Approval usually within 48 hours.
faq_g_q2: Is there a fee to join?
faq_g_a2: Free during the launch period. After launch we plan a small service fee (10-15%) on completed bookings only — never a monthly fee.
faq_g_a3: You set your own prices. You can create multiple package variants (Standard / Premium / VIP) plus add-ons like hotel pickup or photography. Add discounts for early-bird offers.
faq_g_a4: During the free launch, tourists pay you directly (cash or bank transfer). Once payments are enabled in Guideon, payouts will be transferred 2-3 days after the tour is marked complete.
faq_g_a5: Set your available dates in your dashboard. Each tour can have specific dates too. The calendar auto-blocks accepted bookings so you won't be double-booked.
faq_g_q6: Can I cancel a confirmed booking?
faq_g_a6: Yes, but try to give 48+ hours notice. Frequent guide-initiated cancellations may affect your visibility ranking. In emergencies, contact Guideon support and we'll help relocate the tourist to another guide.
faq_a_a1: Click "Forgot password" on the login page. We send a reset link to your registered email (link is valid for 1 hour).
faq_a_q2: How do I enable Two-Factor Authentication?
faq_a_a2: Sign in, then visit guideon.om/two-factor. Scan the QR with Google Authenticator (or any TOTP app) and save your backup codes. Strongly recommended for guides and admins.
faq_a_q3: How do I delete my account?
faq_a_a3: Email admin@guideon.om from your registered address. We confirm and delete within 30 days. Note: bookings and tax records are retained for 7 years per Omani law.
faq_a_a4: Yes. Passwords are encrypted (bcrypt), all traffic uses HTTPS, optional 2FA available, regular security audits. Read our full Privacy Policy.
faq_p_q1: What payment methods do you accept?
faq_p_a1: Currently free — during the launch period you arrange payment directly with your guide (cash, bank transfer, or another method of mutual choice). Online card payments (Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay) will be added soon via Stripe.
faq_p_a2: All prices are in Omani Rial (OMR) — the only currency for payment. The site can display equivalent USD / EUR / GBP for reference using approximate rates.
faq_p_q3: Do you charge a service fee?
faq_p_a3: No fees during the launch period. After launch a small service fee (planned 10-15%) will apply to bookings made through the Platform. We'll always notify you in advance.

contact_faq_sub: Quick answers about how email and communication work on Guideon.
contact_faq_q1: Why didn't I receive my booking confirmation email?
contact_faq_a1: Check your spam/junk folder first — emails from admin@guideon.om can occasionally land there. If still missing after 10 minutes, log in and check your dashboard, or contact admin@guideon.om.
contact_faq_q2: Can I reply to automated emails?
contact_faq_a2: Yes! When you click "Reply" on any Guideon email, your response is automatically routed to admin@guideon.om and reaches our support team within seconds.
contact_faq_q3: How do I stop receiving marketing emails?
contact_faq_a3: Every newsletter has an "Unsubscribe" link at the bottom. You can also log in and adjust your notification preferences in your account settings. Booking-related emails (confirmations, refunds) cannot be disabled for security reasons.
contact_faq_q4: Are my messages and data secure?
contact_faq_a4: Absolutely. All emails use TLS encryption in transit, and we authenticate our domain with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC to prevent spoofing. Read our Privacy Policy for details.
contact_faq_a5: All our emails and support channels are fully bilingual (English & Arabic). You'll receive both versions in the same email, and our team replies in your preferred language.
contact_faq_a6: WhatsApp: under 1 hour. Email: under 24 hours (usually 2–4 hours during Oman business hours). Urgent booking issues are prioritized and replied to within 30 minutes during business hours.
